references.text: Kiriath-Jearim is mentioned as a city in Judah and provides geographical context for where the Danites camped.
Kiriath-Jearim is the place where the ark of the covenant was kept, highlighting the city's significance in Israel's history.
David brought the ark of the covenant from Kiriath-Jearim, confirming the city's important role in Israel's religious history.
The Spirit of the Lord began to stir Samson in Mahane-Dan, the same place that got its name from the Danites' camp described in this text.
